carbs_30.reason: Requires carbohydrate GRAMS per logged meal. The dataset documents 'self-reported time and weighed food intake', i.e. foods and weights, not carbohydrate grams. Deriving grams would need a food-composition table (an estimate, not a recording). Leaving them empty makes the production pipeline compute carbs = 0 / no recent meal, which asserts that the patient did not eat.

decision: No frozen-model evaluation on ShanghaiT2DM: 10 of 33 production inputs (meal carbohydrate grams; steps; heart rate) have no recorded source, and running the model would require fabricating them (0 g carbs, 0 steps). In addition the CGM sampling (15 min) differs from the training data (5 min). Persistence and a separately trained CGM-only real-data model are evaluated instead.
would_change_if: the inspected workbooks contained recorded carbohydrate grams AND step counts AND heart rate (rechecked automatically against the real headers by the audit stage)
